info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Tips-v3-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Tips API provides easy access to valuable delivery tips aimed at enhancing the efficiency and service quality for food delivery operations. By querying this endpoint, developers can retrieve a list of curated tips that are instrumental for delivery personnel in improving their performance during food dispatch. Typical consumers include application developers and logistics managers who seek to integrate best practices into their platforms. This API ensures users have the latest insights to streamline food delivery processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current tip information for deliveries. It provides insights into tips that can be applied to delivery orders, enhancing the customer experience and ensuring adequate driver compensation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a tip for deliveries. Ensure that the correct parameters are set to get the desired tip information.

200.description: Successful retrieval of delivery tip information.
